note.en: Kept apart from the HomePod card on purpose: same family, different film, different music. The bank's record of this same music use is OMT-090 — one recording, one film, so the two are declared siblings rather than two answers.
note.zh: 故意与 HomePod 那张分开：同一系列，不同短片，不同音乐。资料库把这一支广告另记成 OMT-090：同一段录音、同一支短片，所以两张卡互为同题，而不是两个答案。
